panels.title: Estado del producto
panels.description: LISTO exige productor y driver recientes, continuidad de 61 velas en ambos activos, flujo de operaciones activo y siete pronósticos recientes. Un contenedor activo no basta.

panels.title: BTC · último cierre
panels.description: Último cierre confirmado y su evolución en el período elegido.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(open_ms/1000.0) AS time,close::double precision AS value FROM market_candles WHERE symbol='BTCUSDT' AND source_mode<>'replay' AND (open_ms BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()::bigint*1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()::bigint*1000) ORDER BY open_ms

panels.title: Pronósticos vigentes · de 7
panels.description: BTC y SOL: volatilidad, caída y actividad; un pronóstico conjunto SOL−BTC. Frescura máxima: 180 segundos.

targets.rawSql: SELECT now() AS time,count(*)::double precision AS value FROM cp_signal_board WHERE kind='forecast' AND age_seconds<=180

panels.title: 1 · Cuatro dimensiones · un integrante por dimensión
Franck · Volatilidad · pulsa para ver cómo se obtiene
panels.description: 100 % significa que el pronóstico alcanzó su umbral de alerta. Verde por debajo de 80 %, ámbar entre 80 % y 100 %, rojo desde 100 %.

targets.rawSql: SELECT now() AS time,replace(symbol,'USDT','') AS metric,100*value/NULLIF(threshold,0) AS value FROM cp_signal_board WHERE kind='forecast' AND dimension='volatility' ORDER BY symbol

panels.title: Volatilidad · Franck · observada y futura a 15 min
panels.description: Volatilidad realizada = 100√Σ(log-retorno²), sin anualizar. Continua: observada; punteada: pronóstico; puntos: realidad posterior, que solo existe tras 15 minutos completos.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(as_of_ms/1000.0) AS time,replace(symbol,'USDT','')||' · observada' AS metric,observed AS value FROM predictions WHERE dimension='volatility' AND source_mode='live' AND model_version=(SELECT value FROM runtime_configuration WHERE key='active_model_version') AND (as_of_ms BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()::bigint*1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()::bigint*1000) UNION ALL SELECT to_timestamp(as_of_ms/1000.0) AS time,replace(symbol,'USDT','')||' · pronóstico' AS metric,forecast AS value FROM predictions WHERE dimension='volatility' AND source_mode='live' AND model_version=(SELECT value FROM runtime_configuration WHERE key='active_model_version') AND (as_of_ms BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()::bigint*1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()::bigint*1000) UNION ALL SELECT to_timestamp(as_of_ms/1000.0) AS time,replace(symbol,'USDT','')||' · realidad futura' AS metric,actual AS value FROM predictions WHERE dimension='volatility' AND source_mode='live' AND model_version=(SELECT value FROM runtime_configuration WHERE key='active_model_version') AND (as_of_ms BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()::bigint*1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()::bigint*1000) AND actual IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Separación BTC–SOL · Luz Milagros · tamaño |SOL − BTC| a 15 min
panels.description: Tamaño de la separación |SOL − BTC| en puntos porcentuales, sin signo. Continua: observada; punteada: pronóstico; puntos: realidad posterior.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(as_of_ms/1000.0) AS time,replace(symbol,'USDT','')||' · observada' AS metric,observed AS value FROM predictions WHERE dimension='divergence' AND source_mode='live' AND model_version=(SELECT value FROM runtime_configuration WHERE key='active_model_version') AND (as_of_ms BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()::bigint*1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()::bigint*1000) UNION ALL SELECT to_timestamp(as_of_ms/1000.0) AS time,replace(symbol,'USDT','')||' · pronóstico' AS metric,forecast AS value FROM predictions WHERE dimension='divergence' AND source_mode='live' AND model_version=(SELECT value FROM runtime_configuration WHERE key='active_model_version') AND (as_of_ms BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()::bigint*1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()::bigint*1000) UNION ALL SELECT to_timestamp(as_of_ms/1000.0) AS time,replace(symbol,'USDT','')||' · realidad futura' AS metric,actual AS value FROM predictions WHERE dimension='divergence' AND source_mode='live' AND model_version=(SELECT value FROM runtime_configuration WHERE key='active_model_version') AND (as_of_ms BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()::bigint*1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()::bigint*1000) AND actual IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 2 · Riesgo y señales
Riesgo actual · % de cada umbral de alerta
panels.description: 100 % significa que el pronóstico alcanzó su umbral de alerta. Verde por debajo de 80 %, ámbar entre 80 % y 100 %, rojo desde 100 %.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE dimension WHEN 'volatility' THEN 'Volatilidad' WHEN 'crash' THEN 'Caída' WHEN 'anomaly' THEN 'Actividad' ELSE 'Divergencia' END||' · '||replace(symbol,'USDT','') AS "Serie",round((100*value/NULLIF(threshold,0))::numeric,0) AS "% del umbral" FROM cp_signal_board WHERE kind='forecast' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Línea de tiempo · verde normal, ámbar vigilancia, rojo alerta
panels.description: Cada franja es una serie pronosticada. Permite ver de un vistazo cuándo y dónde subió el riesgo.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(as_of_ms/1000.0) AS time,CASE dimension WHEN 'volatility' THEN 'Volatilidad' WHEN 'crash' THEN 'Caída' WHEN 'anomaly' THEN 'Actividad' ELSE 'Divergencia' END||' · '||replace(symbol,'USDT','') AS metric,CASE WHEN triggered AND severity='high' THEN 2 WHEN triggered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS value FROM market_signals WHERE kind='forecast' AND source_mode='live' AND model_version=(SELECT value FROM runtime_configuration WHERE key='active_model_version') AND (as_of_ms BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()::bigint*1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()::bigint*1000) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 3 · Mercado y eventos empresariales
BTC · velas de 1 minuto
panels.description: Velas reales de Binance recibidas por Kafka. Verde: cierre mayor que la apertura; rojo: menor.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(open_ms/1000.0) AS time,open::double precision AS open,high::double precision AS high,low::double precision AS low,close::double precision AS close,volume::double precision AS volume FROM market_candles WHERE symbol='BTCUSDT' AND source_mode<>'replay' AND (open_ms BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()::bigint*1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()::bigint*1000) ORDER BY open_ms

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(open_ms/1000.0) AS time,open::double precision AS open,high::double precision AS high,low::double precision AS low,close::double precision AS close,volume::double precision AS volume FROM market_candles WHERE symbol='SOLUSDT' AND source_mode<>'replay' AND (open_ms BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()::bigint*1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()::bigint*1000) ORDER BY open_ms

panels.title: Flujo neto · compras menos ventas por minuto
panels.description: Cada operación de Binance es un evento empresarial publicado en Kafka (market.trades.*). Spark agrupa por minuto con watermark de 1 min y deduplicación por event_id. Positivo: dominaron las compras agresivas.

targets.rawSql: SELECT window_start AS time,replace(symbol,'USDT','')||' · flujo neto' AS metric,buy_usdt-sell_usdt AS value FROM trade_flow WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 4 · ¿Funcionan los modelos? · prueba 2026 y error en vivo
Modelo contra referencia · prueba histórica y en vivo
panels.description: Prueba enero–septiembre 2026, reservada. En vivo se usa el error absoluto medio del período elegido; es una muestra corta. Detalle completo en el tablero CryptoPulse · Detalle.

targets.rawSql:
WITH v AS (SELECT dimension d,count(actual) n,avg(abs(forecast-actual)) m,avg(abs(baseline-actual)) b FROM predictions WHERE source_mode='live' AND model_version=(SELECT value FROM runtime_configuration WHERE key='active_model_version') AND (as_of_ms BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()::bigint*1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()::bigint*1000) AND actual IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1)
 SELECT CASE x.dimension WHEN 'volatility' THEN 'Volatilidad · Franck' WHEN 'crash' THEN 'Caída · Julmer' WHEN 'anomaly' THEN 'Actividad · Abdul' ELSE 'Separación · Milagros' END AS "Dimensión",
 CASE x.method WHEN 'random_forest' THEN 'Random Forest' WHEN 'logistic_regression' THEN 'Logística calibrada' WHEN 'ridge' THEN 'Ridge' ELSE x.method END AS "Modelo",
 CASE WHEN x.metrics ? 'pr_auc' THEN 'PR-AUC (más es mejor)' ELSE 'RMSE (menos es mejor)' END AS "Métrica prueba 2026",
 round(COALESCE((x.metrics->>'pr_auc')::numeric,(x.metrics->>'rmse')::numeric),3) AS "Modelo · prueba",
 round(COALESCE((b.metrics->>'pr_auc')::numeric,(b.metrics->>'rmse')::numeric),3) AS "Referencia · prueba",
 v.n AS "Evaluados en vivo",round(v.m::numeric,3) AS "MAE modelo · vivo",round(v.b::numeric,3) AS "MAE referencia · vivo",
 CASE WHEN v.m IS NULL THEN 'Madurando' WHEN v.m<0.98*v.b THEN 'Supera' WHEN v.m>1.02*v.b THEN 'Por debajo' ELSE 'Empate' END AS "En vivo"
 FROM model_metrics x JOIN model_metrics b ON b.dimension=x.dimension AND b.model_version=x.model_version AND b.split='test_baseline' LEFT JOIN v ON v.d=x.dimension
 WHERE x.split='test_deployed' AND x.model_version=(SELECT value FROM runtime_configuration WHERE key='active_model_version') ORDER BY x.dimension

target.rawSql: SELECT extract(epoch FROM registered_at)*1000 AS time,'Modelo activo: '||model_version AS text,'modelo' AS tags FROM model_versions WHERE $__timeFilter(registered_at)

SELECT as_of_ms AS time,'ALERTA · '||CASE dimension WHEN 'volatility' THEN 'Volatilidad' WHEN 'crash' THEN 'Caída' WHEN 'anomaly' THEN 'Actividad' ELSE 'Divergencia' END||' · '||symbol AS text,'alerta' AS tags FROM market_signals WHERE triggered AND severity='high' AND source_mode='live' AND model_version=(SELECT value FROM runtime_configuration WHERE key='active_model_version') AND (as_of_ms BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()::bigint*1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()::bigint*1000)
